column1: # Estonian (et) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Estonian video-editing vocabulary (ajaskaala, rada, klipp, jada, salv, esitusnäidik, marker,
# üleminek, võtmekaader). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was
# consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are imperatives ("Salvesta kui…"),
# labels use sentence case, quotation marks are „…“, the ellipsis follows the word without a
# space, and product and format names (CFA4, Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling.
# Decimal comma (0,5). A native-speaker review is welcome.
# Terms: clip = klipp, track = rada, sequence = jada, timeline = ajaskaala, bin = salv,
# playhead = esitusnäidik, marker = marker, label = silt, In/Out point = algus-/lõpp-punkt,
# keyframe = võtmekaader, frame = kaader, caption = pealdis, preset = eelseade, template = mall,
# workspace = tööruum, gain = võimendus, opacity = läbipaistmatus, render = renderdamine,
# ripple = nihutusega, dissolve = sulandus, wipe = pühkimine, voice-over = pealelugemine,
# proxy = asendusfail, guide = juhtjoon, shortcut = otsetee, media = meedia, (Legacy) = (pärand).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see et.tsv.attribution.
